entities.name: Nil Yalter
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nil Yalter is a Turkish contemporary feminist artist. She attended Robert College in Istanbul, Turkey. Her work is included in many collections and museums, which includes drawings, photographs, videos, and performance art. She is the first Turkish female video artist.
